title: org.ligatureprotocol.envelope
description: DRAFT. The one container for every signed fact (ADR 0035). The payload is the encoded fact as bytes and is never re-encoded; the signature is Ed25519 over the byte concatenation of the ASCII prefix "ligature/fact/1", the type and the payload. Verifiers check the bytes as received, then decode the payload and validate it against the schema the type names. The fact identifier is the SHA-256 of the payload bytes.

publicKey.description: A public key as a multibase string with a multicodec prefix (an Ed25519 key renders as z6Mk…).

bytes.description: Bytes as base64url without padding; a CBOR byte string on the wire.

typeName.description: A reverse-DNS type name such as org.ligatureprotocol.device.

type.description: The payload's type: which schema it validates against once decoded.

payload.description: The encoded fact, as transmitted. Stored and forwarded byte-exact.

signer.description: The key that made the signature: a self-signing key, user-signing key, group key or device key. The verifier resolves it to a trusted chain through person facts.
